name: magpie-llm-detector
description: magpie tool plugin: verify which LLM actually serves an endpoint, via model fingerprint detection (powered by lm-detector/lmfpd)
author: aqiu817

summary.en: Model fingerprint detection for every agent: ask an endpoint's model to write a few hundred integers, match the distribution against a reference bank, and see which model is really behind the API. Powered by lm-detector (lmfpd).
summary.zh: 给每个 agent 的模型指纹检测：让端点的模型随手写几百个整数，与参考库比对分布，看清 API 背后真正是哪个模型。基于 lm-detector（lmfpd）。
